All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Document
A document owned by a user, as the resource server lists it.
DocumentAccessException
The documents could not be read: no token could be obtained, the resource server refused it or it is unreachable.
DocumentGateway
Port to the documents on the resource server, read with the token the service client obtained for itself (client credentials).
OnBehalfOfDocumentGateway
Port to the documents on the resource server, read on behalf of a user: the subject token of the user is exchanged for a token for the resource server (RFC 8693).
